name: Crest: Noeinhowell's Interrogation
text:
Whenever you Engage an amulet, activate an ability that hasn't been activated yet in sequence from the following.
1. Deal 3 damage to a random enemy follower.
2. Restore 2 defense to your leader.
3. Recover 1 evolution point. Destroy this crest.
